description: Two PDFs are open in Preview: ~/Documents/Lease/lease-renewal.pdf and ~/Documents/Lease/lease-old.pdf. Safari, Notes, Mail, and Finder are also already open with default content. Using Raycast's window management commands (NOT manual mouse-drag, NOT external tools), arrange the workspace EXACTLY as follows on the current Space: Safari → left half of the screen. The Preview window whose document is lease-renewal.pdf → right half of the screen. Notes → bottom-right quarter. Mail → minimized to the Dock on the current Space (do not move it to another Space). Finder → moved to the NEXT Space (so it disappears from the current Space). Open Raycast's AI Chat (or Raycast Notes if AI Chat is not available in your tier), make it 'Always on Top' via Raycast's window action, and centre it with a reasonable size. The Preview window whose document is lease-old.pdf MUST NOT MOVE — leave its position and size exactly as you found them. Finally, focus Safari so it is the frontmost app.
